text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kilang dan Jentera
(Pengecualian k epada PETRONAS Chemicals Methanol  Sdn. Bhd. ,
Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan) 2020.

Pengecualian

2. Semua jentera yang didaftarkan dengan Ketua Pemeriksa, dengan
nombor pendaftaran dan perihalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)  dan (2)
Jadual Pertama, atas nama PETRONAS Chemicals Methanol  Sdn. Bhd. ,
Wilayah Persekutuan  Labuan yang telah di keluarkan perakuan kelayaka n baginya,
adalah dikecualikan daripada persediaan yang dikehendaki di bawah
perenggan 17(a) dan (b) Peraturan-Peraturan (Pemberitahuan, Perakuan Kelayakan dan
Pemeriksaan) Kilang dan Jentera 1970  [P.U. (A)  43/1970] bagi pemeriksaan ulangan
yang berikutnya selepas habis tempoh perakuan kelayakan itu sebagaimana
yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3).

3.  Semua jentera yang did aftarkan dengan Ketua Pemeriksa , dengan
nombor pendaftaran dan perihalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) dan (2)
Jadual Kedua, atas nama PETRONAS Chemicals Methanol Sdn. Bhd.,
Wilayah Persekutuan  Labuan yang telah dikeluarkan perakuan kelayakan  baginya,
adalah dikecualikan daripada persediaan yang dikehendaki di bawah
peraturan 20 Peraturan-Peraturan Kilang dan Jentera  (Skim P emeriksaan Khas)
(Pemeriksaan Berasaskan Risiko) 2014 [ P.U. (A) 96/2014 ] bagi pemeriksaan ulangan
yang berikutnya selepas habis tempoh perakuan kelayakan itu pada 17 November 2020.

Syarat pengecualian

4. Pengecualian di bawah perenggan 2  dan 3  tertakluk kepada syarat bahawa
pemeriksaan luaran dan ujian tanpa musnah telah dijalankan ke atas semua jentera
yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama dan Kedua dan bahawa Pemeriksa berpuas hati
dengan keputusan pemeriksaan dan ujian itu.

FACTORIES AND MACHINERY ACT 1967

FACTORIES AND MACHINERY (EXEMPTION TO PETRONAS CHEMICALS
METHANOL SDN. BHD., FEDERAL TERRITORY OF LABUAN) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 55(3) of the
Factories and Machinery Act 1967 [Act 139], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation
1. This order may be cited as the Factories and Machinery
(Exemption to PETRONAS Chemicals Methanol  Sdn. Bhd. ,
Federal Territory of Labuan) Order 2020.

Exemption
2. All machinery registered with the Chief Inspector, with the registration numbers
and descriptions as specified in columns (1) and (2) of the First Schedule, in the name
of PETRONAS Chemicals Methanol Sdn. Bhd., Federal Territory  of Labuan which have
been issued with certificates of fitness, shall be exempted from the preparation required
under paragraphs 17(a) and (b) of the Factories and Machinery (Notification, Certificate
of Fitness and Inspection) Regulations 1970 [ P.U. (A) 43/1970] for subsequent regular
inspections after the expiry of such certificates of fitness as specified in column (3).

3. All machinery registered with the Chief Inspector, with the registration numbers
and descriptions as specified in columns (1) and (2) of the Second Schedule, in the name
of PETRONAS Chemicals Methanol  Sdn. Bhd., Federal Territory  of Labuan which have
been issued with certificates of fitness, shall be exempted from the preparation required
under regulation 20 of the Factories and Machinery (Special Scheme of Inspection)
(Risk-Based Inspection) Regulations 2014 [ P.U. (A) 96/2014 ] for subsequent regular
inspections after the expiry of such certificates of fitness on 17 November 2020.

Condition of exemption
4. The exemption under paragraph 2 and 3 is subject to the condition s
that an external inspection and non -destructive tests have been conducted on all

of the machinery specified in the First and Second Schedule and that the Inspector
is satisfied with the result of such inspection and tests.
